author: TeIq
content: Implemented. lettre 0.11 added as workspace dep (rustls-tls, no openssl); migration 41 adds moderator_emails table with queued/sent/failed CHECK; POST /api/cases/{id}/email + GET /api/cases/{id}/emails. Live SMTP delivery via lettre when POLARIS_SMTP_HOST + POLARIS_SMTP_FROM are set; otherwise the row is persisted with status='queued' so the audit trail captures the intent. Credentials tuple enforced as both-or-neither. Recipient address fingerprinted in logs ("abc***@example.com") to avoid PII leakage. 3 unit tests pass (email validation, fingerprint redaction). 535 lib tests pass; clippy -D warnings clean.
